objective: Create plan_importer.py in tools/supervisor/ — baseline skeleton with documented interface
acceptance_criteria: import_plan(), validate_plan(), register_plan() functions are importable
implementation_steps: Read stateful-booping-mountain.md plan file for plan_importer.py specification
Create tools/supervisor/plan_importer.py with functions: import_plan(path), validate_plan(path), register_plan(path)
Each function must have docstring, proper error handling, and type hints
import_plan: copies plan to plans/.claude/<name>.md, returns PlanImportResult
validate_plan: checks plan schema compliance, returns ValidationResult
register_plan: registers in plan registry JSON, returns RegistrationResult
Write tests/supervisor/test_plan_importer.py with at least 3 test cases
focused_validation: python -c "from tools.supervisor.plan_importer import import_plan, validate_plan, register_plan; print('OK')"
evidence_requirements: Test output showing acceptance criteria met
